listing.name: BigBeans Ship Compilation
listing.summary: Provides refined collision models and shield fixes for this ship compilation.
listing.aiSummary: Provides refined collision models and shield fixes for this ship compilation.

description: Offers a patch containing updated .ship files for BigBeans Ship Compilation. These files use smarter point distribution for better accuracy and performance, reduce some collision radii, fix misaligned shields, and resize oversized low-tech shields.
